contract: Proposals only; each slice is intended as one PR. Test files and commands below are future files created by that slice, not existing tests/recipes. Files under part-c are research artifacts; code-owned paths identify intended implementation scope, not edits made by this workhorse.

slices.title: Benchmark schema and synthetic mapping oracle
slices.goal: Define workload/result schema and correctness-only fixture mapping logical operations to each engine.
slices.oracle: Finite fixture executes reference-store transitions, computes SHA256 digest over exact fixture profile bytes, compares each operation to expected transitions and engine capability mapping (R2 metadata_scan unsupported); no timings asserted.

slices.title: D1 workload adapter and native counters
slices.goal: Implement D1 mapping for supported logical operations and capture rows read/written, duration and DB size.
slices.oracle: Local fake D1 metadata fixtures compare returned logical rows and expected billing counter extraction; never assert latency.

slices.title: R2 object workload adapter and operation counters
slices.goal: Implement object get/put/checksum/conditional-delete mapping and classify Class A/B/storage counters; reject SQL-scan equivalence.
slices.oracle: Fake object API fixture validates checksums, opaque locator handling and unsupported scan semantics.

slices.title: redb workload adapter and transaction fixture
slices.goal: Implement local redb operations using current pinned crate and report transaction/correctness data.
slices.oracle: Same deterministic synthetic rows and transaction model as C9133-01; compare reference outputs, not speed.

slices.title: Turso workload adapter and sync state capture
slices.goal: Implement local Turso operations and report local revision/push/pull/network state separately from query timing.
slices.oracle: Local test DB confirms logical rows and explicit sync-state fields; no remote credentials needed for conformance.

slices.title: Run matched local laptop redb and Turso evidence
slices.goal: Run redb/Turso on identical corpus bytes and digest; capture named laptop/runtime/network/cache/storage-shard conditions in validated result-v1 record. Keep local results separate from cloud results.
slices.oracle: Runner verifies one corpus digest shared by both adapters and emits raw samples plus runner/git/hardware/OS/runtime/cache/storage-shard/dataset metadata; no cross-environment winner asserted.

slices.title: Cloud-backed storage evidence run with strict preflight validator
slices.goal: Execute approved D1/R2 cloud storage workloads and publish raw measurements, dated price, durability and source metadata. Does not evaluate recall or recommend shards.
slices.oracle: run_cloud strict CLI parser rejects unknown/malformed flags and validates positive spend cap, provider/region/corpus digest/output before any network, lock, output write or spend; validator checks result schema/dates/units/environment offline. Storage report never asserts search/shard winner; optional #9092 artifact link is schema+digest checked only.
slices.cli_contract: Cloud runner requires --providers d1,r2 --corpus PATH --corpus-digest SHA256 --region REGION --max-spend-usd DECIMAL --result PATH; optional --price-sheet-url URL. Strictly reject unknown/duplicate flags, missing/empty values, malformed digest/region/spend/path before credentials, network, locks, writes or spend. Spend cap is mandatory and finite. Validator is offline: required --input result.json; optional --output normalized.json and --owner-search-result artifact.json; reject unknown/malformed args before file writes. Runner requires explicit approved credentials and never runs during design task.

slices.title: Cache epoch and hot-result contract
slices.goal: Specify local watermark/policy epoch, bounded corpus staleness, immediate revocation, realtime/cache-disable flags and fail-closed behavior against current indefinite cache.
slices.oracle: Generated event-gap/epoch fixtures prove stale policy never serves, hot cache avoids source lookup, and realtime/disable bypasses result cache.
slices.done_command: npm --prefix pkgs/atlas-search/worker exec vitest -- run test/cache_contract.test.ts

slices.title: Migrate indefinite Worker cache to bounded tenant-safe cache
slices.goal: Implement tenant/auth/policy-bound key, pushed corpus watermark, explicit cache flags, immediate revocation fail-closed and bounded eviction.
slices.oracle: State-machine tests assert no stale-policy response and no per-hot-hit Turso lookup; event-loss follows fail-closed path.
slices.done_command: npm --prefix pkgs/atlas-search/worker exec vitest -- run test/cache_policy.test.ts

slices.title: Document store ownership and identity seams
slices.goal: Inventory blob/event/world/sync authorities, redb usage, exact-byte Iroh BLAKE3 IDs, world journal and Atlas content_hash producer gap; avoid generalized store migration claims.
slices.oracle: Inventory table maps each authority to current concrete source and identifies unmapped Atlas content_hash producer; no ID/hash equivalence assumed.

slices.title: Preserve signed-artifact bytes while resolving codec mismatch
slices.goal: Reconcile documented Ed25519 preimage with code SHA256(serde_json::to_vec(SignedBody)); add compatibility vectors without silently changing legacy signature bytes.
owned_files: pkgs/id/crates/id-sync/src/artifact.rs (owner-reviewed, no wire-byte change in this slice)
slices.oracle: Golden signed bytes/signature vectors from current artifact code still verify; any canonical codec is version-tagged and old vectors remain accepted.

slices.title: Evaluate single-writer SQLite sync and restore alternatives
slices.goal: Compare Litestream WAL async DR, Turso Sync last-push-wins, D1 and redb against RPO/RTO/conflict and workload needs; select no backend without evidence.
slices.oracle: Comparison matrix cites primary docs and records conflict/restore semantics for every candidate.
slices.failing_test: not applicable; research artifact validated by source checklist

slices.title: Separate canonical content ID from encrypted object locator
slices.goal: Define trusted/untrusted bucket metadata, opaque locator mapping, broker checks and leakage model without changing global CAS IDs.
slices.oracle: Tenant separation property: same plaintext CAS may map to different opaque locators; ciphertext cannot be read without broker/key; canonical ID remains unchanged.

slices.title: Implement shared-bucket broker authorization
slices.goal: Add per-operation tenant/trust-domain authorization before get/list/head/put/delete; encryption remains separate adapter.
slices.oracle: Generated cross-tenant operation matrix yields deny for all unauthorized actions, including presence/list probes.

slices.title: Specify authoritative generation fence with #9084
slices.goal: Require atomic ref-intent conditional commit and GC tombstone CAS; define g+1 resurrection, orphan upload recovery and conditional physical deletion. Deletion stays disabled until authority exists.
slices.oracle: MBT explores ref-commit versus tombstone interleavings; exactly one outcome: ref committed to live g or GC fenced g; late ref to g rejected; resurrection uses g+1 with same canonical whole-file hash.

slices.title: Build resumable generation-conditional large-object collector
slices.goal: Implement paged idempotent tombstone/grace/delete; reclaim chunks independently while preserving canonical file hash.
slices.oracle: Restart at each page and race writer at fence; delete only the captured physical generation, never referenced generation or newer resurrection.

slices.title: Evaluate second embedder candidates without selecting for owner
slices.goal: Use Snowflake arctic-embed-m-v2.0 as existing model; compare BGE-M3, Voyage, OpenAI text-embedding-3 and Workers AI on cost, self-hostability and mixed corpus; consume only #9092-owned #8627 quality artifacts, do not run/recompute recall.

hard: #9092 #8627 eval/corpus identity and owner-produced artifact if available

slices.oracle: Candidate matrix records #9092-owned fixed recall artifact reference or 'not measured'; includes cost assumptions, self-hostability evidence and owner-undecided status. No independent recall run or model winner.
slices.failing_test: not applicable; research matrix validated for complete candidate coverage

slices.title: Add pipeline-qualified async vectorization contract
slices.goal: Queue accepted content asynchronously with exact provider/model/revision/preprocess identity and idempotent mixed-embedder storage.
slices.oracle: Duplicate jobs produce one pipeline-qualified artifact; differing model identities remain separately addressable; signature and lineage validated before admission.

slices.title: Recommendation snapshot paging state machine
slices.goal: Specify one logical worker, snapshot cutoff, stable next-10 page/cursor, finite dedup and replay horizon, restart and terminal semantics.
slices.oracle: Materialize immutable total order score DESC then immutable recommendation ID ASC at snapshot cutoff. MBT includes equal-score ties, late arrival after cutoff, restart, duplicate page replay within finite horizon, replay expiry, cursor expiry, terminal and empty-nonterminal pages; signed derived output required.
slices.done_command: npm --prefix pkgs/atlas-search/worker exec vitest -- run test/recommendation_state.test.ts

slices.title: Implement durable incremental recommendation accumulator
slices.goal: Implement per-tenant/subject DO with bounded incremental pages, signed outputs and snapshot cutoff semantics.
slices.oracle: Crash/retry at each durable write boundary yields same logical page set and no cross-tenant state.
slices.done_command: npm --prefix pkgs/atlas-search/worker exec vitest -- run test/recommendation_do.test.ts

slices.title: Versioned recommendation object and retention contract
slices.goal: Separate recommendation snapshots from search history, retain comparison versions, apply per-class TTL and deletion/hold policy.
slices.oracle: Finite model preserves pinned snapshots, expires hot intermediates, and honors deletion/hold and signed provenance.

slices.title: Persist recommendation snapshots and before/after comparison
slices.goal: Persist immutable versioned snapshots/history, apply retention worker and expose authorized comparison by pinned snapshot IDs.
slices.oracle: Round-trip compare is stable for pinned IDs; expired unreferenced data collected; retained snapshots remain immutable.
